mapper.select: SELECT r.cadre_id, c.cadre_name, c.post_title, c.unit_name, r.option_id, o.option_content, o.option_type, COUNT(r.result_id) AS votes FROM assessment_result r LEFT JOIN assessment_cadre c ON r.cadre_id = c.cadre_id LEFT JOIN assessment_option o ON r.option_id = o.option_id WHERE r.activity_id = #{activityId} GROUP BY r.cadre_id, c.cadre_name, c.unit_name, r.option_id, o.option_content, o.option_type ORDER BY r.cadre_id, o.option_type, votes DESC
